claims.location: comment[data file], assay name, comment[fraction identifier] rows 1-240
claims.value: 110 deposited .raw files; fractions 1-30 (screen 2) / 1 (NES proteome) / 1-9 (NES TiO2 rounds)
claims.evidence: Screen 2: paper "the proteome was fractionated into 30 fractions (90 samples, three biological replicates (30 per replicate))"; files *_ML_proteome_01-30 (BR1), *_ML_proteome_2_01-30 (BR2), *_LM_proteome_01-30 (BR3) -> fraction = file suffix. MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate assigns ML_proteome_2_01 to A375SR_LM_BR3_proteome (all other _2_ files to ML_BR2); per-file marker ratios (orientation, median +0.93, 91% agreement with S=medium) show it behaves exactly like the other ML_2 files, so it is annotated by its file name as BR2 fraction 1. NES part: proteome_01/02 = BR1/BR2 single injections; phospho_01-09 (BR1) and phospho2_01-09 (BR2) are sequential TiO2 enrichment rounds of one mixture, encoded as fractions 1-9 (paper: "ten rounds of phosphopeptide enrichment per replicate"; only 9 per replicate deposited/searched).

claims.value: ML files: A375 S = SILAC medium, A375 R = SILAC light; LM files: A375 S = SILAC light, A375 R = SILAC medium
claims.evidence: Explicit: file and MaxQuant experiment names "A375SR_ML" / "A375SR_LM" (order S,R -> M,L / L,M) and paper "SILAC labeled A375 S and A375 R cells (light, medium, and vice versa)". MaxQuant multiplicity 2, Labels1 = Arg6;Lys4 (the medium label, reported as H/L columns). Data check: nestin (P48681, paper: median log2 R/S -2.71 in all replicates) log2 (Arg6Lys4/light) = +1.70 ML_BR1, +1.43 ML_BR2, -2.09 LM_BR3 -> nestin high in S = medium in ML and light in LM. Per-file check on 207 consensus marker groups: all 60 ML files median +0.79..+1.18 (89-98% agreement), all 30 LM files -0.56..-0.88 (4-17%).

claims.value: A375 Nes-KO = SILAC light, A375 S = SILAC medium, A375 R = SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: Paper Experimental Design: "In part 2, SILAC labeled Nes-KO, A375 S and A375 R cells were used (light, medium, heavy)"; file names 33SR_LMH (order KO, S, R -> L, M, H); MaxQuant multiplicity 3, Arg6;Lys4 and Arg10;Lys8. Data check: nestin log2 M/L +4.14/+2.21 (S >> knockout), H/M -1.35/-1.64 (R < S, as in screen 2), H/L +2.75/+0.85; log2 H/M correlates positively with the screen-2 R/S marker consensus (r +0.23 BR1, +0.48 BR2), M/L negatively.

claims.value: vemurafenib sensitive / vemurafenib resistant / not available (Nes-KO)
claims.evidence: Paper: "BRAF V600E mutant melanoma cell lines sensitive (A375 S) and resistant to vemurafenib (A375 R)"; R generated by acquired resistance to PLX4720 (vemurafenib analogue) per ref 33 (Sinnberg 2016). Nes-KO clones were derived from A375 S by CRISPR/Cas9; the paper reports their altered (reduced) sensitivity as a finding, so no sensitivity label is asserted (not available). Custom column (phenotype is licensed only by clinical-metadata, which is not declared; spec Extending Templates permits custom characteristics), free text.

Paper: "we induced a NES gene knockout in vemurafenib sensitive A375 S cells using the CRISPR/Cas9 system ... Single clones (A375 Nes-Ko #1-5)". A375 S and R were not edited. Custom free-text column (genotype not licensed by declared templates). Which Nes-KO clone ("33" in file names) was used is not stated.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 110 of 145 deposited .raw files annotated. Excluded (listed in report and BLOCKED.md): (a) 33 screen-1 runs 20150812_A375SR_Phospho_BR1_01-10, 20150814_A375SR_Phospho_BR2_01-10, 20150822_A375SR_Phospho_BR3_01-10, 20150818_A375SR_Proteome_BR1/BR2, 20150822_A375SR_Proteome_BR3 - their MaxQuant experiments are all named "ML" but deposited ratios show label orientation flips (proteome BR1 and phospho BR2/BR3 behave as S=medium; proteome BR2/BR3 and phospho BR1 as S=light; and the proteome and phospho runs of the same nominal BR disagree), so no explicit per-run channel map exists (batch rules 6/7); (b) 2 patient FFPE runs 20181129_MaS_meltissue_preBRAFi_FFPE_01 and 20181129_MaS_meltissue_postBRAFi_FFPE_01 - the deposited FFPE search covers a different, undeposited run (20181211_MaS_prepostBRAfi_dimethyl_LH_1ug, dimethyl light/heavy), so the label state of the deposited runs is undocumented, and individual-level clinical data (Supplementary Information S3) could not be retrieved.

Supplementary files (Supplementary Information S1/S3, Supplementary Figures incl. Fig S1A workflow) could not be downloaded: PMC returned bot-check HTML, Europe PMC supplementaryFiles returned an empty archive, mcponline and Unpaywall PDF returned 403.
techsdrf is not installed; instrument/NCE/TopN were read from HTTP-range raw headers of 8 sampled files only.

MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate assigns 20180707_MaS_A375SR_ML_proteome_2_01 to A375SR_LM_BR3_proteome; it is annotated by its file name as screen-2 BR2 fraction 1 (SILAC medium = S) because its per-file ratios match the ML orientation (median +0.93, 91% agreement).
The paper says 10 phospho enrichment rounds per part-2 replicate (22 samples); only 9 rounds per replicate (20 files) are deposited and searched.
The Nes-KO clone used for SILAC (file token "33") is not identified in the accessible text; phenotype for Nes-KO left not available.

Derived lines A375 R and A375 Nes-KO carry the parental Cellosaurus accession CVCL_0132 (no Cellosaurus entries exist for them); distinguished by characteristics[phenotype]/[genotype] (custom columns, free text; not licensed by declared templates).
comment[cleavage agent details] records the digestion enzymes Trypsin + Lys-C; MaxQuant search rule was Trypsin/P.
Precursor mass tolerance 4.5 ppm is the MaxQuant main-search tolerance (first search 20 ppm).
ms-proteomics is declared at v1.2.0 (upstream bigbio/sdrf-templates 7da1747 latest); the spec submodule's nested templates copy is older.

Channel orientation cross-checks use marker sets derived from the screen-2 experiments themselves (anchored on the published nestin direction); they confirm per-file consistency, not independent ground truth.
